summary: The comments request changes to the NPRM portion of the Draft Order, including requesting it be changed to a Notice of Inquiry (NOI) and requesting a longer comment period of 90 days for Initial Comments and 120 days for Reply Comments. The comment opposes sunset provisions for E-Rate funding and argues that changes to the program could impact its eligibility and implementation. The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate funding, citing cost savings and requesting revisions to the final order.
